title: Grilled Cheese Burritos
instructions: Lay out a burrito tortilla and layer with sour cream, queso, Spanish rice, your choice of meat, creamy chipotle sauce, tortilla strips, and shredded cheese.
Roll the burrito up tightly, folding in the sides as you go.
Heat a griddle or skillet over medium heat. Sprinkle a small pile of shredded cheese onto the hot surface and place the burrito seam-side down on top of the cheese.
Let it cook for about a minute until the cheese is golden and starts to crisp up.
Carefully flip and cook the other side until warmed through and lightly toasted.
Serve with extra queso, salsa, or sour cream if you'd like!
notes: Just like Taco Bell... but better! And they definitely don't cost $10 each. So easy, so filling, and always a crowd favorite! From: Home with the Bridgmans on Facebook.
